scope: R3 consensus API multiple-endpoint probe completed; other RPC/VM/account/transaction/fork probes and full task 9 remain open.

contract.targets: Every recorded execution node; auth client selected by each endpoint. Probes finish before PreSpec and hooks.
contract.classification: All supported permits execution. Any unavailable/unusable node yields unknown/BLOCKED. If all are observable and one lacks its consensus method, unsupported/SKIP. Unknown outranks unsupported. Existing unexpected runtime skip policy still yields FAIL.
contract.provenance: capability-probes.json nodes include index, role, status, source, reason and validator count. Original primary-node fields retained. Raw transport errors/credentials are omitted.
contract.bound: Sequential calls bounded at five seconds per node and caller cancellation; number of calls grows with the node set.

limitations: Actual method-unavailable and mixed unsupported/unknown cases use authenticated unit fixtures. Native binaries qualify real support and a genuinely unreachable endpoint; no RPC replies are fabricated by the gateway.
Consensus support is API availability, not equality of validator sets or finality correctness.
No browser UI source changed; browser was not separately rerun in this stage.
Initial fixture import placement caused a compilation failure; final fixed-source full check and four-package race passed before native proof.
